results.title: Safedrive dreamer: Navigating safety–critical scenarios in ...
results.content: ## Alexandria Engineering Journal. # Original Article Safedrive dreamer: Navigating safety–critical scenarios in autonomous driving with world models. This study proposes Safedrive Dreamer, integrating world models, CMDP, and safety learning to improve autonomous driving. To address this issue, this study proposes the Safedrive Dreamer navigation framework, which aims to reduce the reliance on trial-and-error learning in real-world scenarios, thereby mitigating the risks associated with dynamic driving conditions and enhancing vehicle foresight. Furthermore, to reduce trial-and-error costs in real-world applications, this study employs PAC-Bayesian methods to derive generalization error bounds between simulations and reality, enabling a more effective transfer of knowledge and experience from simulations to real-world scenarios. This study provides new insights into the integration of world models into decision-making processes to enhance decision-making capabilities in safety–critical applications, thereby contributing significantly to the improvement of autonomous driving safety and reliability. :   These authors contributed equally to this work.
